metadata.scope: Remaining 8 original assay groups; branch/taxon-limited candidates, not whole-Echinoidea replacement
metadata.search: primer length18–27nt; each 3prime endpoint shift−20..+20nt; COI S extended−50..+50nt and genus-label groups; minimum3 records per group; ordinary no degeneracy; D first covers all observed final3 then optional internal variants cap16 per primer
metadata.gates: all design records both primers<=2 mismatches with final3 exact; original and new scanned on same target/background files; background four counts not exceeding original; all IUPAC variants expanded; structureTm<55C, oligoTm45–75C, midpoint deltaTm<=5C in both 50nM/variant and 200nM/direction scenarios; 50mM monovalent,1.5mM Mg,0.6mM dNTP; no adapters; priority only if structure margin>=5C
metadata.validation: Independent full-sequence Python paired scan equals C++ exhaustive scan; additional direct validation at intended shifted positions with exact final3; cross F/R background scan and all-variant pool dimers; separate PCR recommended
metadata.limitations: same panel used for design and selection; no holdout or wetlab validation; existing local taxon labels, not new tree inference; genus-level groups not demonstrated monophyletic; non-target panel incomplete; specificity to the selected clade vs other echinoids not established
